article.title: Tripo推出Agentic Canvas，以可編輯節點串連3D製作
article.title_en: Tripo launches Agentic Canvas with editable 3D production workflows
article.summary: Tripo於11月2日公布新工作空間，可把生成、修改及匯出步驟連起來。
article.summary_en: Tripo announced a workspace connecting generation, refinement and export on November 2.
highlights: 代理可先生成流程，再由使用者檢查及修改節點。
流程可儲存、複製及批次套用到多個素材。
highlights_en: An agent proposes a workflow that users can inspect and edit.
Workflows can be saved, duplicated and applied to batches of assets.
article.why: 製作多個商品或場景素材的團隊，可評估重用流程能否改善交接與一致性。
article.why_en: Teams producing product or scene assets can evaluate reusable workflows for consistency and handover.
article.next_step: 先以一款產品試做，檢查幾何、貼圖、匯出格式與收費。
article.next_step_en: Test one product, checking geometry, textures, export formats and charges.
article.detail: 節點代表個別操作，連線把上一步輸出交給下一步。按公告，可加入貼圖、網格重整、UV處理及骨架設定等步驟，也可在AI 3D Lab用對話檢查或修改素材。這次重點是把既有3D能力組成可重用流程，並非證明所有輸出已適合商用。品牌仍需檢查實物比例、標誌與材質，以及素材權利和方案限制；公告沒有提供獨立生產成效測試。
article.detail_en: Nodes connect operations such as texturing, retopology, UV work and rigging. AI 3D Lab adds conversational inspection and refinement. Reusable workflows do not establish commercial readiness: brands still need to check product accuracy, rights and plan limits.
